title: Same phenotype, different mechanisms: What five selectively bred rat lines reveal about the heterogeneity of human alcohol use disorder
title_zh: 相同表型，机制不同：五条选择性育种大鼠线揭示人类酒精使用障碍的异质性
abstract: For seventy-five years, rats have been selectively bred for high voluntary alcohol consumption, yielding five major lines -UChB/UChA, P/NP, HAD/LAD, AA/ANA, and sP/sNP-msP- that share a behavioral phenotype but arose independently on three continents. This review argues that these lines are best understood as phenocopies: they reach high consumption via largely distinct biological routes rather than a single shared mechanism. Line by line, we synthesize the biochemical, genetic, and brain-circuitry explanations for the high-drinking phenotype, and compare them directly. The genetic architecture ranges from a single large-effect nonsense variant validated through a knockout in P rats, through a dispersed, predominantly regulatory polygenic architecture in HAD/LAD, to an enzyme-affinity locus with a direct human counterpart in UChB/UChA. Critically, a same-method comparison of all five lines reveals almost no molecular convergence at the level of individual genes, and in at least two neurotransmitter systems -opioid and CRF/stress- the direction of change associated with high consumption is directly opposite between lines. We read this as evidence that the heterogeneity of human alcohol use disorder is not merely an artifact of the difficulty of studying human populations, but a property of the phenotype itself. Because the line-to-subtype mapping is so far established for only two of the five lines, we frame the translational implication as a hypothesis rather than a prescription: that human AUD comprises mechanistically distinct subtypes, each corresponding to a different line's route to high consumption, best examined through prospective clinical stratification rather than by defaulting to any single model as definitive.
abstract_zh: 在过去七十五年里，研究人员对大鼠进行选择性育种，以获得高自愿性酒精摄入的品系，产生了五条主要线——UChB/UChA、P/NP、HAD/LAD、AA/ANA，以及sP/sNP-msP——它们共享相同的行为表型，却在三大洲独立出现。本综述认为，这些品系最好被视为表型复制体：它们通过大体不同的生物学途径实现高摄入，而非单一共享机制。逐条品系，我们综合了高饮酒表型的生化、遗传和脑回路解释，并直接进行比较。其遗传结构从P大鼠中通过敲除验证的单一大效应无义变异，到HAD/LAD中分散且主要为调控型的多基因结构，再到UChB/UChA中具有直接人类对应的酶亲和位点。关键的是，对五条品系进行同一方法比较，几乎没有在单个基因层面上出现分子趋同；在至少两条神经递质系统——阿片类和CRF/压力——中，高摄入相关的变化方向在不同品系之间相互相反。我们将此解读为人类酒精使用障碍的异质性不仅是研究人类人群困难的产物，更是表型本身的属性。由于目前仅在两条品系中建立了线与亚型的映射，我们将其转化意义框定为假设而非处方：人类AUD由机制上不同的亚型组成，每个亚型对应不同品系实现高摄入的路径，最好通过前瞻性临床分层来研究，而不是默认任何单一模型为决定性。
